blocks.text:
**Duration:** 10 days / 9 nights  
**Dates:** 12–21 February 2027  
**Route:** Rio de Janeiro, 3 nights + Búzios, 6 nights  
**Format:** Group tour with an English-speaking guide

## Prices and hotels

Prices in US dollars per person for the full programme. SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TRP triple occupancy. Breakfast basis, or similar; hotels may be replaced by others of the same category.

| Category | Rio de Janeiro + Búzios | SGL | DBL | TRP |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 3* | ibis Copacabana Posto 5 + Rio Buzios Beach | $5,225 | $3,255 | $3,330 |
| 4* | Windsor Leme + Rio Buzios Boutique | $6,566 | $3,865 | $3,680 |
| 5* | Miramar by Windsor + Rio Buzios Boutique Deluxe sea view | $8,075 | $4,915 | $4,275 |

Carnival tickets and hotel – Sambadrome – hotel transfers are included. International flights, optional excursions, and food and drinks during transfers are charged separately. The recommended dinner at Marius costs $130 per person.

## Trip highlights

Ten days combining the Carnival’s grand finale, the Parade of Champions in Rio de Janeiro, with Sugar Loaf and Christ the Redeemer, and six nights on the beaches of the Búzios peninsula.

The first three nights are in Rio. The cable car to Sugar Loaf offers views of the city and bay, followed by a tour of the old centre. On the evening of Day 2, the Parade of Champions takes place at the Sambadrome, with music, dancing, Carnival costumes and moving floats. A transfer back to the hotel follows the parade.

Day 3 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour excursion to Corcovado: an open train climbs through the Tijuca Forest to the statue of Christ the Redeemer (38 m), at about 710 m, inaugurated in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf. We recommend watching the sunset from the rocks of Arpoador, and seafood at the Marius restaurant in the evening (around USD 130 per person).

After Rio, spend six nights in Búzios. Days 5–9 · A beach holiday on the Búzios peninsula: ride a buggy or take a boat trip, relax on its many beaches, and spend the evenings on the Orla Bardot promenade and Rua das Pedras.

Day 10 · Breakfast and transfer to Rio de Janeiro Airport for your international flight. End of services.
